description: VERDI tests vibration-based damage identification on a stone-masonry tower representing a structure within a building aggregate. The 1:7 specimen is approximately 6.30 metres tall. Records cover ambient and forced vibration, earthquake excitation, material tests and observed damage states, supporting checks of structural-health-monitoring methods. The dataset is provided by LNEC, Lisbon through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2026. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
